---
description: "Reassess an M365 agent choice after new catalog evidence, a blocker, or a reviewed result."
---

Apply the [M365 Agent Navigator instructions](../agents/m365-agent-navigator.agent.md)
to the supplied prior task, recommendation, and new evidence or sanitized result.
Identify what changed and which eligibility gate or acceptance check failed.
Use the host, expected versus actual output, and prior attempts; distinguish
denied access, partial retrieval, wrong results, and poor task fit without
guessing the cause. Offer at most one materially different diagnostic check
for a plausible input issue, not another retry of a known failing route.
Decide whether to keep the route, improve the brief, or choose an eligible
alternative without weakening source authority, authorization, or draft-only
restrictions. Explain why and prepare a revised handoff only when justified.
Do not run agents or presume that the named paths contain accessible content.
If the failure is unclear, ask one focused question rather than guessing.
